results.reader_more: Simulated reshoring and friendshoring of five strategic EU product groups reduces their modeled EU consumption-based emissions. Multiregional input–output modeling with alternative supplier scenarios for pharmaceuticals, batteries, steel and semiconductors. Hypothetical shifts, not realised job reshoring or carbon savings; effect sizes vary by product.
